outputs.name: cppAdapter
outputs.description: The cppAdapter is the AuditAdapter for C and C++ files, with id 'cpp', label 'C and C++', profiles 'dapp' and 'lib', extensions .c, .cc, .cpp, .cxx, .h, .hh, .hpp and .hxx, and optionalTools 'clang-tidy' and 'clang-format'. Its audit(file) method returns only the file-length and curly-function findings, plus 'cpp-header-namespace' for .h, .hh, .hpp and .hxx files that contain 'using namespace std;' and 'cpp-include-direction' for '#include' lines whose quoted path starts with '../', and it does not run the optionalTools.
